name: Equation
justification: Any valid pair of composites is accepted, so the token checker cannot judge it — disqualified as a special judge.
solution_sketch:
Take b = 2n and a = 3n for n >= 2 (both composite), or the constant pair 9 8 style fix for n = 1; simplest uniform answer is a = 3n, b = 2n with a special case for small n.
Multiple correct outputs exist, so a special judge is required.
